import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
from h import *
K = key(0,'A','install')
def one(events, **kw):
    t = trace('a', [K]+list(events), idle_ms=0, **kw)
    r = run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]
    return r

# overlap reject vs first
ev = [dg(1,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='6162',fin=False)])]),
      dg(2,[pkt('A',1,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=1,data_hex='ff',fin=False)])])]
r = one(ev); print('OV-reject', r['packets'], r['streams'], r['connection']['code'])
r = one(ev, overlap='first'); print('OV-first', r['packets'], r['streams'], r['connection']['code'])
# identical overlap ok
ev = [dg(1,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='6162',fin=False)])]),
      dg(2,[pkt('A',1,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=1,data_hex='62',fin=False)])])]
r = one(ev); print('OV-ident', r['packets'], r['streams'])
# crypto limit and overlap per level
r = one([dg(1,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=0,data_hex='0102')])]),
         dg(2,[pkt('I',1,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=31,data_hex='03')])])], crypto_limit=32)
print('C1', r['packets'], r['crypto'])
r = one([dg(1,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=0,data_hex='0102')])]),
         dg(2,[pkt('I',1,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=1,data_hex='ff')])])])
print('C2', r['packets'], r['crypto'])
r = one([dg(1,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=0,data_hex='0102')])]),
         dg(2,[pkt('I',1,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=1,data_hex='ff')])])], overlap='first')
print('C3', r['packets'], r['crypto'])
# CRYPTO at Z -> preflight PROTOCOL_VIOLATION
r = one([dg(1,[pkt('Z',0,[F(type='CRYPTO',offset=0,data_hex='01')])])], early=True)

r = one([dg(1,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='HANDSHAKE_DONE')])])])
